title: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sents.t: If you hate dolls, then you'll probably want to skip this one, as what's captured in it is just terrifying.
sents.zh: 如果你讨厌玩偶，那这一段你最好跳过，因为拍到的东西实在太吓人了。

sents.t: A girl is playing with her doll when the following happens.
sents.zh: 一个女孩正在玩她的玩偶，接着发生了下面的事。

sents.t: Be sure to pay close attention to the doll, or you'll miss it.
sents.zh: 一定要仔细盯着玩偶，不然就错过了。

sents.t: As she plays with her toy, the doll moves its head all on its own.
sents.zh: 她玩的时候，玩偶自己转动了头。

sents.t: Now, it could be that the doll has a built-in feature that allows it to move.
sents.zh: 当然，也可能是玩偶本身有能动的功能。

sents.t: But based on how she reacted upon seeing this, it seems like this wasn't a feature built into the doll.
sents.zh: 但从她看到后的反应来看，这似乎不是玩偶自带的功能。

sents.t: Viewers seem to agree and suggest that the doll is haunted, but as always, I'll let you be the judge of that.
sents.zh: 观众似乎也这么认为，说这个玩偶闹鬼，但和往常一样，由你来判断。
